column2: an electrical schematic wire: a green line with one right-angle bend and a small solid dot at each end
a schematic net label: a small pointed tag shape attached to the end of a short wire
a schematic power symbol: a short vertical line topped by a wide horizontal bar
a PCB copper track: a thick copper-coloured trace with a 45-degree bend joining two round pads
a PCB via: a round copper annular ring with a dark drilled hole in the centre
a PCB copper pour: an irregular copper-filled polygon with a slightly darker outline
undo: a curved arrow turning back to the left
zoom to fit: a magnifying glass inside four corner brackets
layers: three stacked flat square sheets in different colours, seen at an angle
